messages:
olivia_cs: FYI forwarded a customer report — they say retrieval+rerank quality dropped immediately after the latest rollout. complaining about missing citations and lower recall on long-tail queries :frowning: they provided queries and expected docs.

maria_eng: can you paste one or two repro queries + the 'before' vs 'after' outputs? need concrete examples to triage.

olivia_cs: pasted below (they scrubbed PII). customer query: "latest Q3 tax regulation changes affecting supplier onboarding"
- before (v1.9 reranker + embeddings-2025-11): top doc IDs: [doc_341, doc_129, doc_77] with clear inline citations
- after (reranker-v2 + embeddings-2026-a): top doc IDs: [doc_88, doc_341, doc_400] but doc_88 is unrelated, doc_129 dropped out. customer says answers lost grounding and hallucinated a regulation number.

sam_infra: deploy-bot shows a canary rollout 1818998000 -> reranker-v2 (100% canary -> promoted at 1819001800). tagged: "rerank-v2, sparse+dense fusion changes". also note embeddings service rolled a minor release 1818999000 same window.

maria_eng: hmm could be embedding drift or a change in fusion ordering (we changed MMR weighting to favor dense earlier). increasing dense weight can hurt recall for niche docs.

jordan_prod: tagging ops_oncall and infra. ops_oncall do we have retrieval logs for that customer (corpus snapshot, retrieval k, query embedding vectors)? need L2 similarity deltas.

ops_oncall: grabbing logs now. also seeing a spike in avg retrieval distance for that customer's org around 1819000000. exporting top-k vectors and scores for a few queries, will upload to shared S3.

maria_eng: can you run a quick local rerank with the old scoring (v1.9) vs rerank-v2 over the customer's seed queries? I can run a diff on features (bm25 score, dot, MMR penalty).

olivia_cs: customer already did a basic AB: pinned their env to v1.9 and quality returned. they want explanation and ETA. they're escalated to SOC level.

maria_eng: priority then. initial hypothesis list: 1) embedding space shifted (new embed model changed nearest neighbors) 2) reranker scoring change (MMR dense bias) 3) index corruption/rsmash during deployment 4) tokenization mismatch if we started using a different tokenizer in scoring pipeline.

sam_infra: index integrity check shows no corrupted shards. vector dimensions match (1536). but noticed the embed service changed normalization (L2 vs none) flag in release notes — that would affect nearest neighbors strongly.

maria_eng: that could be it. if normalization removed, dot product vs cosine changes neighbor ordering. mitigation options: - re-normalize vectors at query-time as hotfix - rollback embeddings service to previous config - pin customer to earlier model in routing

jordan_prod: quick mitigation: set routing override for the customer's org to model_tag: v1.9-rerank for next 24h. can we do that?

ops_oncall: I can apply routing override in <10m and monitor. will also enable debug logging for their calls (no PII).

deploy-bot: deploy event: routing override applied to org:acme-supposedly at 1819004200 by ops_oncall.

olivia_cs: sent customer confirmation and asked for more failing queries. they appreciate the quick pin. asking for a root cause timeline.

maria_eng: action items: (a) re-run offline nearest neighbor eval between embeddings versions on a held-out retrieval set (b) compare rerank score contributions (dense vs sparse) for failing examples (c) prepare rollback plan for embed service if needed. I'll take (a) and (b).

sam_infra: I'll prepare embed-service rollback playbook and verify there are no incompatible downstream consumers that expect the new normalization.

jordan_prod: I'll draft a short RCA timeline for customer: summary, mitigations, next steps, ETA for RCA (24 hours).

olivia_cs: customer asked whether this could be detection/alerting gap. they want an automated eval to catch this in future.

maria_eng: agreed — we should add a daily retrieval/regression check: compute Recall@k and MRR on a small curated suite of customer-like queries and alert on >5% drop vs baseline. filing ticket.

ops_oncall: upload with logs + sample vectors: s3://redwood-escalations/1819002222/ (shared).

olivia_cs: thanks everyone. will keep customer updated. adding label: escalation/high and linking workspace ticket #CS-4281.

maria_eng: leaving one more note — if embed normalization is root cause, we should be careful when promoting embed config changes across canary; they need a pinned eval that runs at promotion time.

jordan_prod: noted. next sync 2pm PT. :calendar:
